notablePrerequisites:
Your devotion to green is at least two.
Rex does not have summoning sickness.
Karametra's Acolyte and Pili-Pala exiled with a brain counter on them.
description:
Activate Rex using Karametra's Acolyte's ability by tapping it, adding at least {G}{G}.
Activate Rex using Pili-Pala's ability by paying {2} and untapping it, adding one mana of any color.
Repeat.
